entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 16:9 playable overhead football arena background for a polished adult web game. Direct vertical orthographic overhead view, no perspective. A beautiful small urban five-a-side football ground at evening, emerald fine turf, surrounding warm-lit terraced stands, architectural details and thin floodlight reflections. Entire rectangular field fills central horizontal playable area, rectangle approximately x=10%..90%, y=23%..88% of image. Goals at midpoint of left and right short edges. Field must be entirely flat and clear, no people, balls, labels or HUD. Sparse subtle white football markings at center and penalty boxes; avoid perspective bending. Rich realistic painted 3D game art, crisp professional material detail, premium sports game feel. Outer edge decorative architecture, central field remains evenly lit and very legible. No logos, no text, no watermark. Landscape 16:9.
